description: A consolidated computer tool for macOS screen, pointer and keyboard operations. Supports actions: screen_size, cursor_position, screenshot, mouse_move, mouse_click, mouse_drag, scroll, type_text, key_press, list_windows.

path.description: Optional absolute path for the PNG. Defaults to a temp file. Only for screenshot action.

pid.description: Process ID for targeting. Only for screenshot and list_windows actions.

window.description: Window ID for targeting. Only for screenshot action.

include_overlays.description: Include overlay windows in list_windows results. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of windows to return in list_windows. Defaults to 40.

x.description: X coordinate in display points. Required for mouse_move, mouse_click, mouse_drag, scroll actions.

y.description: Y coordinate in display points. Required for mouse_move, mouse_click, mouse_drag, scroll actions.

button.description: Mouse button for click/drag actions. Defaults to 'left'.

clicks.description: Number of clicks for mouse_click action. Defaults to 1.

from_x.description: Starting X coordinate for mouse_drag action.

from_y.description: Starting Y coordinate for mouse_drag action.

to_x.description: Ending X coordinate for mouse_drag action.

to_y.description: Ending Y coordinate for mouse_drag action.

duration_ms.description: Duration of drag in milliseconds. Defaults to 300.

delta_y.description: Vertical scroll delta. Positive scrolls down. Required for scroll action.

text.description: Unicode text to type. Required for type_text action.

key.description: Key name or chord (e.g., 'return' or 'cmd+shift+t'). Required for key_press action.

target_pid.description: Target process ID for per-app targeting.
